usage: music-tagger match [-h] --evidence EVIDENCE --candidates CANDIDATES
                          [-o OUT]

Score candidates by duration match against local evidence.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --evidence EVIDENCE   Evidence JSON from `read`.
  --candidates CANDIDATES
                        Candidates JSON from `mb search`.
  -o, --out OUT         Output JSON file (prints digest to stdout).
